fields.label: Location
fields.note: Free-text location box in the WP Job Manager widget.

fields.label: Employment type
fields.note: Native checkbox values are full-time, internship, part-time, temporary, freelance; a live POST with filter_job_type[]=full-time returned the two current cards.

notes: WordPress WP Job Manager widget. It POSTs to /jm-ajax/get_listings/ with search_keywords, search_location, filter_job_type[] (multi), remote_position=1, per_page, orderby, order and page. A live POST with filter_job_type[]=full-time returned the two current cards, so the endpoint and field names are confirmed.
